squat.counting: One descent and return is one repetition
squat.phases: Stand; hips back and down; stand

wall-pushup.counting: One approach and press away is one repetition
wall-pushup.phases: Hands on wall; bend elbows; press away
wall-pushup.contacts: Palms on wall and both feet planted

calf-raise.counting: One heel raise and lower is one repetition
calf-raise.phases: Feet flat; rise onto forefeet; brief top hold; lower heels

shoulder-circle.variant: Relaxed backward shoulder rolls, upper-body view
shoulder-circle.counting: One complete shoulder circle is one repetition
shoulder-circle.contacts: Standing body stable; arms hang loosely

reverse-lunge.counting: Each backward lunge and return is one repetition; loop shows two
reverse-lunge.phases: Step back; lower; rise; return; switch legs
reverse-lunge.contacts: Front sole stays fixed; back foot supports on forefoot

pushup.counting: One controlled descent and press is one repetition
pushup.phases: High plank; bend elbows; press up
pushup.contacts: Both palms and forefeet stay grounded

standing-knee.counting: Each knee lift and replace is one repetition; loop shows two
standing-knee.phases: Lift left bent knee; replace; lift right bent knee; replace

side-step.phases: Lead foot steps out; trailing foot follows; reverse
side-step.contacts: Only the swing foot leaves the floor

glute-bridge.counting: One hip lift and lower is one repetition
glute-bridge.phases: Supine with bent knees; lift hips; brief top hold; lower
glute-bridge.contacts: Head, upper back and soles supported

bird-dog.counting: Each opposite arm/leg reach and return is one repetition; loop shows two
bird-dog.phases: Hands and knees; reach one diagonal; return; switch diagonal
bird-dog.contacts: Support palm and opposite knee remain fixed

plank.counting: Time-based hold; one static reference frame

sit-stand.counting: One rise and controlled return to the seat is one repetition
sit-stand.phases: Sit; lean forward; stand; controlled sit
sit-stand.contacts: Feet planted; seat supports pelvis during seated pause

seated-knee.counting: Each bent-knee lift and return is one repetition; loop shows two
seated-knee.phases: Sit tall; lift one bent knee; lower; switch
seated-knee.contacts: Pelvis supported on seat; other foot on floor

kb-deadlift.counting: One lift from the floor and controlled return is one repetition
kb-deadlift.phases: Grip floor bell; extend hips to stand; hinge and return bell; brief floor reset
kb-deadlift.contacts: Both soles planted; both hands maintain handle grip

goblet-squat.counting: One squat and stand is one repetition
goblet-squat.phases: Hold bell at chest; squat; stand
goblet-squat.contacts: Both soles planted; hands share bell grip

db-curl.counting: One curl and lower with both arms is one repetition
db-curl.phases: Upper arms at sides; bend elbows; lower

band-pull.variant: Standing band pull-apart at chest height
band-pull.counting: One opening and controlled return is one repetition
band-pull.phases: Arms ahead; open arms to sides; return
band-pull.contacts: Feet planted; band endpoints held throughout

kb-swing.counting: One backswing and forward float is one repetition
kb-swing.phases: Hinge into backswing; hip drive; chest-height float; return to hinge
kb-swing.contacts: Both feet planted; long arms and shared handle grip

kb-reverse-lunge.counting: Each lunge and return is one repetition; loop shows two
kb-reverse-lunge.phases: Goblet hold; step back; lower; rise through front leg; return; switch
kb-reverse-lunge.contacts: Front sole stays fixed; rear forefoot supports lowering; shared bell grip

kb-upright-row.variant: Two-hand kettlebell upright row to lower chest
kb-upright-row.counting: One lift and controlled lower is one repetition
kb-upright-row.phases: Stand tall; lift close to body; lower without swinging
kb-upright-row.contacts: Both soles planted; hands share handle; elbows below shoulders

kb-bent-row.variant: Single-arm bent-over row, left arm, staggered stance with the right hand on the front thigh
kb-bent-row.counting: One row and lower, per side
kb-bent-row.phases: Flat-back hinge with soft knees; row the elbow back until the bell reaches the hip; lower under control
kb-bent-row.contacts: Both feet planted; one-hand grip; shoulder stays down

kb-side-lunge.counting: Each shift and return to centre is one repetition; loop shows two
kb-side-lunge.phases: Wide stance; bend one knee and sit back; return; repeat other side
kb-side-lunge.contacts: Both feet planted; bell held at chest; nonworking leg stays long

kb-side-bend.variant: Standing kettlebell side bend, bell in the left hand, right hand on the hip
kb-side-bend.counting: One bend and return, per side
kb-side-bend.phases: Tall; bend toward the bell as it slides down the outer thigh toward the knee; return to tall
kb-side-bend.contacts: Both feet planted; loaded arm hangs straight; bell rests against the outer thigh

kb-curl.variant: Two-hand kettlebell curl by the horns, thumbs up
kb-curl.phases: Arms long, bell in front of the thighs; curl to the chest; lower slowly
kb-curl.contacts: Both feet planted; both hands on the horns; upper arms still beside the ribs, elbows just in front of the hips

kb-halo.variant: Standing two-hand horns-grip kettlebell halo, alternating directions
kb-halo.counting: Each full circle is one repetition; loop shows two circles
kb-halo.phases: Front reset with base up; first side with base rearward; rear with base down and elbows raised; other side with base rearward; front reset; reverse direction
kb-halo.contacts: Feet planted; head and torso steady; palms wrap opposite horns continuously; straight wrists; the bell rotates in the hands without detaching
kb-halo.camera: Fixed three-quarter upper-body crop; planted feet remain constrained outside crop
kb-halo.timing: 128 frames at 16 fps; eight-second loop with brief front resets

neck-flexion.variant: Standing chin-to-chest neck flexion, upper-body view
neck-flexion.counting: One lower, hold and lift is one repetition

neck-extension.variant: Standing look-up neck extension, upper-body view
neck-extension.counting: One look up, hold and return is one repetition

side-neck.variant: Alternating ear-to-shoulder side flexion, front upper-body view
side-neck.counting: Each tilt and return is one repetition; loop shows both sides
side-neck.phases: Tilt left; hold; return; tilt right; hold; return

overhead-reach.variant: Standing overhead reach with interlaced fingers
overhead-reach.counting: Time-based hold; loop eases into the stretch, holds, and returns
overhead-reach.phases: Move into the stretch; hold; return

triceps-stretch.variant: Standing overhead triceps stretch, three-quarter side view; one side shown
triceps-stretch.counting: Time-based hold; loop eases into the stretch, holds, and returns
triceps-stretch.phases: Move into the stretch; hold; return
triceps-stretch.contacts: Hand on the raised elbow; feet planted

cross-body-shoulder.variant: Standing cross-body shoulder stretch; one side shown
cross-body-shoulder.counting: Time-based hold; loop eases into the stretch, holds, and returns
cross-body-shoulder.phases: Move into the stretch; hold; return

behind-back-clasp.variant: Standing hands-clasped chest stretch, arms straight and lifted, front three-quarter view
behind-back-clasp.counting: Time-based hold; loop eases into the stretch, holds, and returns
behind-back-clasp.phases: Move into the stretch; hold; return

torso-extension.variant: Standing lumbar extension with hands on hips
torso-extension.counting: One lean back and return is one repetition
torso-extension.phases: Upright; lean back; return without holding
torso-extension.contacts: Both feet planted; hands on hips

side-bend.variant: Alternating standing side bend with overhead reach, front view
side-bend.counting: Each bend and return is one repetition; loop shows both sides
side-bend.phases: Reach and bend left; return; reach and bend right; return

oblique-twist.variant: Alternating standing trunk rotation, hands clasped at chest height, elbows out, front-above view
oblique-twist.counting: Each turn and return is one repetition; loop shows both sides
oblique-twist.phases: Turn left; return; turn right; return

cat-cow.counting: One cat and one cow is one repetition
cat-cow.phases: Round back, head down; return; belly sinks, head up; return
cat-cow.contacts: Hands under shoulders; knees under hips

quad-stretch.variant: Standing quadriceps stretch; one side shown
quad-stretch.counting: Time-based hold; loop eases into the stretch, holds, and returns
quad-stretch.phases: Move into the stretch; hold; return
quad-stretch.contacts: Standing foot planted; hand on ankle

hamstring-stretch.variant: Standing hamstring stretch, heel down and toes up; one side shown
hamstring-stretch.counting: Time-based hold; loop eases into the stretch, holds, and returns
hamstring-stretch.phases: Move into the stretch; hold; return
hamstring-stretch.contacts: Front heel and back foot on the floor

hip-flexor-lunge.variant: Half-kneeling hip-flexor stretch; one side shown
hip-flexor-lunge.counting: Time-based hold; loop eases into the stretch, holds, and returns
hip-flexor-lunge.phases: Move into the stretch; hold; return
hip-flexor-lunge.contacts: Back knee and front foot on the floor

reclined-twist.variant: Supine knee rolls (reclined spinal twist), view from the feet
reclined-twist.counting: Each roll and return is one repetition; loop shows both sides
reclined-twist.phases: Roll knees left; return; roll right; return
reclined-twist.contacts: Shoulders and arms flat on the floor

wide-pushup.counting: One lower and press is one repetition

close-pushup.variant: Close-grip push-up, elbows by the sides
close-pushup.counting: One lower and press is one repetition

staggered-pushup.variant: Push-up with staggered hands; one side shown
staggered-pushup.counting: One lower and press is one repetition

stacked-pushup.variant: Push-up with one foot stacked on the other (chart-defined)
stacked-pushup.counting: One lower and press is one repetition
stacked-pushup.contacts: Palms and the lower forefoot grounded

raised-leg-pushup.counting: Each push-up is one repetition; loop shows both legs
raised-leg-pushup.phases: Lower; press while lifting one straight leg; return; switch
raised-leg-pushup.contacts: Palms and the supporting forefoot grounded

spiderman-pushup.counting: Each push-up is one repetition; loop shows both sides
spiderman-pushup.phases: Lower while drawing the knee to the elbow; press; return; switch
spiderman-pushup.contacts: Palms and the supporting forefoot grounded

decline-pushup.variant: Decline push-up, feet on a chair seat
decline-pushup.counting: One lower and press is one repetition
decline-pushup.contacts: Palms on the floor, feet on the seat

clapping-pushup.counting: One explosive press and landing is one repetition
clapping-pushup.phases: Lower; explode; clap in the air; land; reset
clapping-pushup.contacts: Forefeet grounded; hands leave the floor briefly

power-pushup.variant: Plyometric push-up, hands leave the floor
power-pushup.counting: One explosive press and landing is one repetition
power-pushup.contacts: Forefeet grounded; hands leave the floor briefly

pike-pushup.variant: Pike push-up from an inverted V
pike-pushup.counting: One lower and press is one repetition
pike-pushup.phases: Inverted V; lower head toward the floor; press

sit-ups.variant: Bent-knee sit-up, hands behind the head
sit-ups.counting: One curl up and down is one repetition
sit-ups.contacts: Feet and pelvis on the floor

reverse-crunches.counting: One curl and lower is one repetition
reverse-crunches.phases: Tabletop legs; curl knees in; lower
reverse-crunches.contacts: Back and arms on the floor

bicycle-crunches.counting: Each side is one repetition; loop shows both
bicycle-crunches.phases: Knee in with opposite elbow; switch

flutter-kicks.contacts: Lower back and arms on the floor

leg-raises.variant: Supine straight-leg raise to about 45 degrees
leg-raises.counting: One raise and lower is one repetition
leg-raises.contacts: Lower back and arms on the floor

superman.counting: Time-based hold; loop lifts, holds, lowers
superman.contacts: Hips and belly on the floor

back-lifts.variant: Prone chest lift, hands by the temples (chart-defined)
back-lifts.counting: One lift and lower is one repetition
back-lifts.contacts: Hips and legs on the floor

alt-arm-leg-plank.variant: High plank with opposite arm and leg reach, alternating (chart-defined)
alt-arm-leg-plank.counting: Each side is one repetition; loop shows both

shoulder-taps.counting: Each tap is one repetition; loop shows both
shoulder-taps.contacts: Supporting palm and both forefeet grounded

plank-jump-ins.variant: Plank jump-in to crouch and back
plank-jump-ins.counting: One in and out is one repetition

tricep-extensions.counting: One press up and lower is one repetition

pseudo-planche.variant: Pseudo planche lean from a high plank (chart-defined)
pseudo-planche.counting: Time-based hold; loop leans in and back

tricep-dips.counting: One lower and press is one repetition
tricep-dips.contacts: Hands and feet on the floor

fly-steps.variant: Standing hinge with rear leg lift, arms out, alternating (chart-defined)
fly-steps.counting: Each side is one repetition; loop shows both
fly-steps.phases: Hinge and lift; hold; return; switch

side-leg-raises.counting: Each raise is one repetition; loop shows both

punches.variant: Jab and cross from a fighting stance

chest-expansions.variant: Standing chest expansions with alternating cross
chest-expansions.counting: Each open and cross is one repetition

chin-ups.counting: One pull and lower is one repetition

pull-ups.counting: One pull and lower is one repetition

doorframe-rows.counting: One pull and return is one repetition
doorframe-rows.contacts: Feet planted, hands on the frame

kb-clean.variant: Single-arm kettlebell clean to the rack, left arm
kb-clean.counting: One clean from the backswing to the rack
kb-clean.phases: Rack; drop into the hinge; backswing; hip drive; elbow pulls back and in; hand comes around the bell; soft landing in the rack
kb-clean.contacts: Both feet planted; one-hand grip; bell rests on the outside of the forearm in the rack

kb-press.variant: Single-arm strict overhead press from the rack, left arm
kb-press.counting: One press from the rack to lockout and back
kb-press.phases: Rack; forearm vertical as the bell passes the face; lockout with the biceps by the ear; controlled lowering to the rack
kb-press.contacts: Both feet planted; one-hand grip; bell on the back of the forearm

kb-snatch.counting: One snatch from the backswing to lockout
kb-snatch.phases: Lockout; bell turns over and drops into the backswing; hip drive; high pull; punch through; lockout
kb-snatch.contacts: Both feet planted; one-hand grip; bell on the back of the forearm at lockout

kb-getup.variant: Turkish get-up with a high bridge, bell in the left hand; the knee sweeps into a half-kneel, then the lifter stands up with the feet together
kb-getup.counting: One full get-up to standing and back down
kb-getup.phases: Lie with the bell pressed; roll onto the planted right elbow; post on the hand; high bridge; sweep the straight leg under the hips so the knee lands with the shin pointing back; push off the hand to an upright half-kneel; stand up from the lunge, stepping the back foot up beside the front foot, and stand tall; reverse every step
kb-getup.contacts: Bell-side foot planted throughout; elbow, hand, heel, knee and back toes pinned in their stages (the back toes slide in as the weight moves forward before the step); back and forearm roll on the floor during the roll; bell arm locked and vertical throughout; eyes on the bell on the floor
sources: Girls Gone Strong: Mastering the Turkish get-up

kb-pullover.variant: Standing two-hand kettlebell pullover, hands on the horns, bell upside down
kb-pullover.counting: One arc over the head, lower behind the head and back to the chest
kb-pullover.phases: Bell upside down at the chest, hands on the horns beside the handle; carry it up over the head with the elbows bent; lower it behind the head; bring it back over the head to the chest
kb-pullover.contacts: Both feet planted; both hands on the horns; elbows bent throughout; ribs down, no low-back arch
